models_evaluated: multi-instance learning deep learning model fusing WLI and NBI images

links.outcome: Laryngologist AUC and accuracy with versus without AI assistance in human-machine comparison
links.effect: AI significantly improved AUC and accuracy for all 12 laryngologists (p < 0.05); diagnostic abilities and consistency improved, particularly for junior laryngologists.
links.quote: In the human-machine comparison, AI significantly improved AUC and accuracy for all laryngologists (p < 0.05).

links.outcome: Model AUC on internal versus external multi-hospital validation sets
links.effect: AUC 0.868 internal and 0.884 external (two other hospitals, 1617 images); video validation AUC 0.825 (95% CI 0.704-0.946).
links.quote: The model achieved the highest area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) values of 0.868 and 0.884 in the internal and external validation sets, respectively.

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic performance of a deep learning model on endoscopic images/videos and conducts a reader study comparing clinician performance with vs. without AI assistance.
